hooks.command: echo '=== BE Tests ===' && (cd BE && NODE_ENV=test JWT_SECRET=test-secret-at-least-32-characters-long CLIENT_ORIGIN=http://localhost:5173 node --test tests/*.test.js 2>&1 | grep -E 'pass|fail|✔|✘' | tail -5) && echo '=== FE Lint ===' && (cd FE && npm run lint 2>&1 | grep -E 'error|warning|problem' | tail -8) && echo '=== Done ==='
